auth.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with a number and a symbol.
auth.loginHint: Sign in to begin the rite. Your grimoire is bound to your account.
auth.registerHint: No account yet? Make one. It costs nothing and asks for nothing but an email.
auth.errorInvalid: That email and password did not match. Try again.
auth.errorExists: An account with that email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.errorWeak: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters, with a number and a symbol.
auth.errorGeneric: The gate would not open. Try again.

coldStart.heading: Name what you already love
coldStart.intro: The rite serves the unknown, but it needs a bearing first. Choose five bands you already know; their sound becomes the centre from which we drift outward.
coldStart.loadError: The list would not load. Try again.
coldStart.seedError: Your bearing could not be set. Try again.
coldStart.lastFmIntro: Fifteen years of scrobbles say more than five picks. If you have a Last.fm account, seed your taste from what you already play.
coldStart.lastFmUnavailable: Last.fm import is not available yet — the key that unlocks it is not in place. Choose bands above for now.
coldStart.lastFmNoMatch: None of your top artists is in the catalogue yet. Choose bands above instead.
coldStart.lastFmError: The import failed. Try again, or choose bands above.

search.heading: Search the grimoire
search.placeholder: Name a band. Darkthrone, Wardruna, Neurosis…
search.hint: Type at least two letters. Spelling need not be exact.
search.empty: Nothing answers to that name here. Try another spelling.
search.error: The grimoire would not open. Try again.

artist.notFound: That page has been torn out. The band is not in the grimoire.
artist.error: The page would not load. Try again.
artist.noTags: No tags recorded. The margin is quiet here.
artist.noBio: No biography gathered. Nothing has been written about this band yet.
artist.noLineage: No lineage mapped yet. Shared members arrive with the Bloodline pass.
artist.noReleases: No releases recorded yet. The tape was never pressed.

rite.heading: The Rite
rite.subheading: A band, served blind. No name, no genre, no country, no cover — forty-five seconds. It is revealed only if you summon it.
rite.tasteError: Your taste could not be read. Try again.
rite.sliderLabel: Comfort to Abyss: how far from your taste to reach
rite.percentileWindow: Reaching the {{low}}th–{{high}}th percentile of distance from your taste.
rite.serveError: The rite would not begin. Try again.
rite.blindHint: No name until you decide. Judge by ear.
rite.audioError: This preview would not play. Invoke another.
rite.resolveError: That could not be recorded. Try again.
rite.whyNothingShared: Nothing overt connects it to your grimoire yet — this is the reach paying off.
rite.banishedBody: Cast out, and it stays blind — you judged it without knowing its name. It may return to the rite in six months.
rite.againBody: Skipped, neither summoned nor banished. Your taste is unchanged.
rite.emptyBody: Either you pushed the slider into the abyss and nothing servable lives that far out, or you have already invoked everything this close. Move the slider back, loosen the filters, or return later.

grimoire.heading: Your grimoire
grimoire.error: Your grimoire would not open. Try again.
grimoire.emptyBody: Nothing summoned yet. Begin the rite and summon what you like — each one is inscribed here.

lineup.title: Lineup timeline
lineup.hint: Point at a release to light up who was in the band
lineup.emptyBand: No lineup traced yet. Member dates arrive when the band's people are gathered — the underground is thin here.
lineup.emptyPerson: No bands traced yet. This person's memberships have not been gathered.

graph.empty: No connections to draw. This node stands alone in the graph.
graph.hint: Drag to pan · scroll to zoom · click a node to open it

lineage.error: The lineage would not load. Try again.
lineage.bloodlineHint: Shared members and declared influence. Click a node to open it.
lineage.diasporaHint: When this band broke up, its members scattered. Where each went next.
lineage.diasporaEmpty: No dated diaspora traced. Either nobody has left for a dated later band, or the members' next bands are not in the grimoire yet.
lineage.bandsEmpty: No memberships on record. This person's bands have not been gathered.
lineage.rabbitHoleHint: A guided walk down the lineage — each band leads to the next by a shared member or an influence.
lineage.rabbitHoleDeadEnd: The hole is shallow here — this band's neighbourhood runs out fast. Try one with more connections.
lineage.pageIntro: The blood and the network of the underground. Two questions that take two bands: how they connect, and what lives between them.
lineage.sixDegreesHint: The shortest chain of shared members connecting two bands.
lineage.noPath: No path connects these two in the graph we hold. They may be joined by members we have not gathered.
lineage.missingLinkHint: What lives between two bands? We take the midpoint of their sound and find its nearest neighbours.
lineage.noEmbedding: One or both of these bands has no embedding yet, so the space between them cannot be interpolated.
lineage.grimoireGraphHint: Only the bands you have summoned, and the blood between them. Click a node to open it.
